q: The quantum Rényi entropy of order α for a density matrix ρ is defined as S_α(ρ) = (1/(1−α)) log tr(ρ^α). As α → 1, this converges to:
opts: The von Neumann entropy S(ρ) = −tr(ρ log ρ)
exp: By L'Hôpital applied to tr(ρ^α)/(1−α): lim_{α→1} S_α(ρ) = −tr(ρ log ρ) = S(ρ). The quantum Rényi entropies form a family parameterised by α, with S₁ = von Neumann entropy as the special case.
